alignment_contract.task_alignment: sorted task_id (lexicographic v3d-001..v3d-180), one-to-one deterministic; N=180 for query-level dimensions; per-gold grade N=228 total distinct gold identities union across A/B (union N=228; shared identities=228; ABSENT pairs=0; derived mechanically from existing reviewer_A/B raw bytes without relabeling); no semantic relabeling, no regeneration, no readjudication, no heuristic seeds; mechanical sentinel ABSENT for missing gold identity; grade categories are stringified original grades '1','2','3' plus sentinel 'ABSENT'; sentinel is not a semantic grade, it is explicit mechanical absence representation; string conversion of booleans via str() ('True'/'False') for answerable/ambiguous; stratum categories are 8 prereg strata strings.
alignment_contract.normalization: No query text normalization for agreement; exact string equality on stratum/source_truth_answerable/ambiguous/gold grade categories as stored in raw JSONL; gold identity is (source, source_id) exact string pair; grade is stringified original grade or ABSENT sentinel; confusion counts are raw integer counts; expected agreement = sum_{cat} (count_a(cat)/N)*(count_b(cat)/N); kappa = (observed-expected)/(1-expected); if denominator 0 then kappa=1 if observed==1 else 0.
alignment_contract.per_gold_grade_canonical: Union of gold identities per task across A/B; each identity contributes one pair (grade_A_or_ABSENT, grade_B_or_ABSENT); N = len(union) across all tasks; categories = {'1','2','3','ABSENT'}; sentinel transparently reported; shared-identity-only diagnostic optionally included but canonical is union+sentinel as documented; no silent coercion of ABSENT to '0' or other grade.
alignment_contract.per_gold_grade_shared_diagnostic: Only identities present in both A and B for same task; N_shared = count of shared identities; same grade categories without sentinel; purely diagnostic.

per_gold_grade.sentinel_meaning: ABSENT = gold identity present in other annotator but not in this one; not a semantic grade; mechanical absence representation

location_bearing.note: location is non-prereg, diagnostic only; prereg requires stratum/source_truth_answerable/ambiguous/per-gold grade

prereg_compliance: §4 requires durable raw agreement + Cohen's κ for stratum/source-truth answerability/ambiguity/per-gold grade; this artifact provides N, raw, expected, κ, counters, confusion recomputable from exact input SHAs via deterministic contract above; per-gold grade canonical uses union+sentinel ABSENT transparently, shared-only diagnostic also included.
